This is the shop page. The form opens as soon as the price shows up.
There is no link in what was shared

On a product page in a shop app or in the browser, tap Share and choose “Add to Wishlist”.

The page is read right on this phone, so name, price and photo come through even from shops that block automatic requests. Then the Wishlist form opens — check the fields and tap Add.

It usually takes 3–10 seconds. If the shop asks you to prove you're not a robot, you'll see the page and can do it.
